scope: execution status and limitations only; numerical scientific tables preserved

paragraphs.old: We audit an independent MIFlu reproduction and 28 forecasting implementations on a 966-row US national influenza series. The supplied reproduction table gives mean squared error (MSE) 1.4995 versus the published 1.4355, with lower MSE at two horizons and higher MSE at two. Under three benchmark seeds, MIFlu, PatchTST and NLinear achieve 1.5574, 1.6621 and 1.8716. A joint screen using literature-derived timing and intensity tolerances yields 4/16 passing aggregated cells for both NLinear and MIFlu and 0/16 for PatchTST. NLinear has lower mean peak-intensity error but higher mean timing error than MIFlu. Across 11 arms with parameter exports, the MSE–log-parameter fit has slope +0.1171 and R² 0.0223. An audit identifies an incorrect Holm routine in the supplied analysis: correcting 136 comparisons among 17 models yields no rejections, with NLinear–PatchTST p approximately 0.1172. This does not establish equivalence. Eleven frozen language encoders perform worse than a decision tree in the tested readout configuration. Ablation completion is owner-reported at 60/60 and is not aggregated. The findings are descriptive and limited to one split, retrospective peak detection and adapted implementations. We recommend reporting peak magnitude and timing alongside average error, then selecting on validation-defined costs and budgets before prospective deployment.

paragraphs.old: 本文审计 MIFlu 的独立复现及美国全国流感 966 行序列上的 28 个预测实现。复现表平均 MSE 为 1.4995，原文为 1.4355，逐跨度两低两高。三种子基准中，MIFlu、PatchTST、NLinear 分别为 1.5574、1.6621、1.8716。采用文献容差的联合筛选下，NLinear 与 MIFlu 各通过 4/16 聚合单元，PatchTST 为 0/16。NLinear 峰高误差更低，但时间误差高于 MIFlu。11 个有参数导出的模型中，MSE 对对数参数的斜率为 +0.1171，R² 为 0.0223。源 Holm 程序存在错误；修正 17 模型的 136 配对后，没有拒绝，NLinear–PatchTST 的 p 约 0.1172，不能据此证明等价。11 个冻结语言编码器在所测读出配置中均差于决策树。消融仅有用户报告的 60/60 完成，尚未聚合。结论受单次划分、回顾性峰检测及适配实现限制。建议并列报告峰高、时间与平均误差，并在前瞻部署前依验证阶段确定的代价与预算选模。

paragraphs.old: Paper-based reasoning. The Transformer paper explains masking that prevents attention to subsequent positions [24, §3.1]. With the inspected ordering, time positions cannot acquire later text through these layers, and the head reads time positions. This is a structural argument about a fixed forward path, not certification of repository runtime or bitwise equality. The three archived assertions must control weights, inputs and evaluation randomness when comparing changed text and matched full/no-text outputs. They remain not executed. Independent training can consume randomness differently and requires its own test.
